entries.title: Fictional Zone A
entries.text: Zone A is the main-stage zone. For this fictional demo, drinking water and toilets are beside the main-stage exit. A staffed help point is beside the zone entrance.

entries.title: Fictional Zone B
entries.text: Zone B is the water-tent zone. For this fictional demo, drinking water is at the water tent, toilets are behind the tent and a staffed help point is beside it.

entries.title: Fictional Zone C
entries.text: Zone C is the entry zone. For this fictional demo, drinking water, toilets and a staffed help point are beside the entry gate.

entries.title: Reporting an issue
entries.text: Choose the incident zone, describe what you saw and flag immediate concern when needed. A chat draft has not been submitted until you confirm and receive a report reference. A web report does not guarantee a response; use the event's established emergency procedure for immediate help. Confirmed assistance requests can create in-app offers to available volunteers; this prototype has no emergency-service connection.

entries.title: Staff reporting and escalation
entries.text: Volunteers and Mo can submit reports. Volunteers can escalate their own or assigned incidents to Mo. Mo reviews urgent and unclear safety situations. An acknowledgement or escalation leaves the incident open. Only Mo, an assigned volunteer or the original reporter can explicitly confirm resolution. AI suggestions cannot confirm resolution or dispatch a responder. Confirmed assistance requests use nearest available general-helper offers. An offer is not acceptance or arrival. Volunteers must opt in with fresh GPS and keep the app open; skills and coverage checks are not implemented.
